stem: A circle has centre M, AB is a diameter and BC is the tangent at B. The angle of tangency ∠ABC stands on the semicircle AB and equals the inscribed angle on that arc. Calculate $m(\angle ABC)$: drag A, B and C so the inscribed angle on the semicircle AB has that same measure.
solution: The arc between the sides of ∠ABC is the semicircle AB, whose measure is 180°.
So set the inscribed angle on this arc to 90°.

hints.text: The angle is a fraction of the arc it faces, not the arc itself.
Check that C faces the arc that lies between the sides of the angle of tangency.
Find the measure of the arc AB cut off by a diameter, then apply the half rule.
